acceptance_criteria: New query `Kernel::face_plane(&self, s, face: SubShape) -> Result<(Point3, Point3), KernelError>`: a point on the face's plane and its unit outward normal. A non-planar face, a `SubShape` whose kind isn't `Face`, or an index out of range is `InvalidInput`. Documented and implemented for `OcctKernel`; the new shim function is `noexcept` and catches C++ exceptions, and its `unsafe` call is in `ffi` with a SAFETY comment.

New variants `Extent::ToFace(SubShape)` and `Extent::BetweenFaces(SubShape, SubShape)`, documented. `ToFace` runs from the workplane to the face's plane. `BetweenFaces(a, b)` runs from the plane of `a` to the plane of `b`, ignoring the workplane offset. `Kernel::extrude` rejects both with `InvalidInput`, as it does `ThroughAll`.

`extrude_feature` accepts both in `Join`, `Cut` and `Intersect` modes; `NewSolid` or a missing target is `InvalidInput`, checked before any geometry is built. A face behind the workplane is allowed (the extrude goes against the normal).

Geometry tests with the stepped target T = `make_box((0,0,0),(40,25,10))` joined with `make_box((0,0,0),(20,25,30))` (volume 20000, a step face at z = 10 for x in 20..40, a top face at z = 30 for x in 0..20). Tests find faces by calling `face_plane` on each face, not by hard-coded index. Volumes within 1e-6 relative: Cut, 10 × 10 square from (5, 7.5) on `Workplane::XY`, `ToFace(top z = 30)`: volume 17000. Same square, `ToFace(step face z = 10)`: volume 19000. Same square, `BetweenFaces(step z = 10, top z = 30)`: volume 18000, bounding box unchanged. Join, 10 × 10 square from (25, 7.5) on `Workplane::XY`, `ToFace(top z = 30)`: volume 22000, bounding box max z 30.

Errors, each with a test and never a panic, all `InvalidInput`: a side face of T (normal ±X); a non-planar face (the curved face of a cylinder target); a face in the workplane itself (zero length, T's bottom face at z = 0 with `ToFace`); `BetweenFaces` with two coplanar faces; a face index out of range; a `SubShape` of kind `Edge`; `ToFace` with `NewSolid`.
No new dependencies. `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M3-02b: Extrude extents "to face" and "between faces" (planar faces parallel to the workplane, by face index)
